title: Healthcare & Wellness Practices
standingRules: Never include symptoms, conditions, treatments or any health detail in briefs, notifications or CRM notes — reference threads by sender and subject category only.
Scheduling messages confirm time and location only; clinical questions route to clinical staff verbatim and unsummarized.
Review responses never confirm someone is or was a patient — thank, keep it generic, take it offline.
urgency: anything suggesting a medical emergency (route immediately, never draft a reply)
compliance: Treat all inbound content as potential PHI: minimum necessary handling, no PHI in any system not named in the profile as BAA-covered.
Marketing communications require documented patient consent on file.

corridorHints.daily-brief: Counts and categories only — the brief must never contain message content.
corridorHints.review-response: HIPAA applies to reviews: never acknowledge a care relationship in public replies.
